Connect Four Coins in a Row

Connect Four Coins in a Row

How to play?

Connect Four is a one-player game against an AI opponent.

Taking turn, each player drops a coloured coin to one of the 7-columns of the board. The coin will then travel down to the next empty row in that column.

The first player to form a connection of four coins horizontally, vertically, or diagonally wins the game. If the board is completely filled but no one has won, the game is a draw.
